channels.name: officer_control_observed
channels.method: Source-reviewed original camera frame and ego body entry join
channels.uncertainty: police authority and legal control unresolved

channels.name: officer_direction_observed
channels.method: Independent review of original camera pixels
channels.uncertainty: programmed bone pose is not an observation

channels.name: through_speed_mps
channels.method: Original through actor get_velocity joined to same Native frame
channels.reference_frame: Native source frame and through actor identity
channels.uncertainty: speed alone does not establish immediate hazard or legal yield duty

channels.name: through_highway_sight_clear
channels.method: Independent four-camera through-highway sight review joined to original Native frames
channels.reference_frame: source camera frame; original ego view
channels.uncertainty: Visibility is a reviewed diagnostic observation; human recognition and legally nearest view remain unresolved

channels.name: ego_distance_to_junction_m
channels.method: Original complete ego body minimum plan-view distance to sourced junction polygon
channels.uncertainty: Polygon distance does not establish a legally sufficient viewpoint

channels.name: through_vehicle_position
channels.method: Original through actor complete body polygon and centroid
channels.uncertainty: Synthetic fixture geometry cannot establish real hazard

channels.name: through_vehicle_speed
channels.method: Original through actor get_velocity magnitude joined to Native frame
channels.uncertainty: Speed does not define immediate hazard

channels.name: ego_crossing_body
channels.method: Original ego complete body polygon and junction overlap
channels.uncertainty: Overlap does not determine right of way

channels.name: ego_approach_speed
channels.method: Original ego get_velocity magnitude joined to Native frame
channels.uncertainty: No statutory numeric slowing threshold is inferred

context_inputs.name: officer_context
context_inputs.method: Saved finalizer joins original officer identity, route and junction sources to source-reviewed four-camera frames; authority and legal control unresolved
context_inputs.uncertainty: Physical police authority, proper sign erection and actual traffic control require original-source review

context_inputs.name: yield_site_review
context_inputs.method: Independent hash-bound original camera sign and sight review plus Native OpenDRIVE and body geometry; legal judgments unresolved
context_inputs.uncertainty: Physical sign propriety, human nearest view, immediate hazard and legal priority remain unresolved

limitations: Synthetic software fixtures do not establish physical officer authority, gesture visibility, traffic control, nearest-view sufficiency or legal compliance.
